scheme_name: Scholarship to the Ward of Beneficiary (CBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Worker must be registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1965 and have regular contributions received by the Board
Worker must have been a beneficiary member of the Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for at least six months
Scholarship is limited to a maximum of two children per worker
Application must be submitted within three months of the issuance of the student’s mark sheet
Scholarship will not be granted if the child already receives a scholarship from any other institution
Scholarship will not be entertained if the student obtains a compartment in any subject
Students placed 1st, 2nd or 3rd in national/international games or sports receive the scholarship irrespective of academic marks
benefits_summary: Scholarship amounts range from ₹3,000 to ₹5,000 for 10th and 12th grades based on percentage of marks, and a one‑time ₹7,500 for graduation (60% or higher).
documents_required: Clear picture of both sides of Aadhaar Card
Clear pictures of all pages of the BOCW copy issued by the Board
